confidence_notes: Food estimates use [Numbeo's crowdsourced Chania prices](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Chania), which have a limited contributor base. Cocktail and wine estimates are about 2.5 and 1.5 times the beer price, informed by [Chania nightlife](https://crete.direct/en/articles/chania-nightlife-bars-clubs) and [Crete drinks](https://creteinsider.com/prices-in-crete/) guides. Accommodation is a general-knowledge estimate; July demand, location and private hostel room availability make it less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation estimates use tourism-oriented Cretan cities such as Rethymno and Heraklion as a regional basis, with an allowance for Chania's peak July demand.
